name: Racism And Slavery
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of slavery and regulates its practice, forbidding the stealing and selling of people (Exodus 21:16) while permitting the purchase of bondmen and bondmaids from surrounding nations (Leviticus 25:44). God's justice is impartial, not showing favoritism or accepting bribes (Deuteronomy 10:17). Additionally, the Bible commands kindness and love toward strangers, reminding God's people that they themselves were once strangers in Egypt and should therefore neither oppress nor vex those who dwell among them (Exodus 22:21; Leviticus 19:33-34).
